tools.name: search_stays
tools.description:
Multi-operator accommodation comparator for a geographic area and a stay:
dates (required), guests and optional filters. Returns a ranked list of
properties — hotels, B&Bs, apartments, villas, hostels and more — with the
booking sites that offer each one and their live availability and
per-operator

tools.name: get_property_details
tools.description:
Details and guest reviews for one specific property — hotel, B&B,
hostel, apartment, villa — identified by its id. Answers questions such
as what guests think of it, whether it is clean, quiet or comfortable,
the most common complaints, how the breakfast is, which facilities it
offers, where exactly

tools.name: check_property_availability
tools.description:
Live availability and per-operator quote for a specific property
over a specific stay window. Performs a live date-aware lookup
against the BluePillow search layer, returns date-specific prices,
rooms-left scarcity signals, breakfast-included and refundable
flags, and a per-operator deep link to com

tools.name: get_anonymous_key
tools.description:
Issues a free anonymous key for Blue Pillow Hotels & Stays, with no
account or sign-up. The other tools of this server take the key in their
`api_key` argument. A key does not expire, so the same key can be used
for later calls; calling this tool again issues a new one. Keys carry
per-key rate limit

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
